figures.finding: Bosnia and Herzegovina's entities have no rule of their own for child performers: in the Federation no one under fifteen may be engaged in any kind of work, and a minor of fifteen to eighteen works with the legal representative's consent and a medical certificate, at most 35 hours a week, never overtime or at night; in Republika Srpska work starts at fifteen with the parents' written consent and a medical finding, no overtime, and night for minors runs 19:00-06:00.

Puno radno vrijeme za maloljetne radnike ne smije biti duže od 35 sati sedmično.
Zabranjen je noćni rad maloljetnih radnika.
Radni odnos sa licem mlađim od 18 godina može da se zasnuje samo uz pismenu saglasnost roditelja, usvojioca ili staraoca
Za radnike mlađe od 18 godina noćnim radom smatra se rad između 19.00 časova i 06.00 časova narednog dana.

figures.finding: In the Federation full capacity comes at eighteen or on earlier marriage; a minor's employment contract needs the legal representative's consent. No share of earnings is set aside by law.
figures.applies: Federation of BiH Family Law art. 157 (as layer 3 holds it) and the labour laws above.
